items.title: 트럼프 “다음은 쿠바”…‘나토 탈퇴’ 가능성도 내비쳐 - 한겨레

summaries.en: President Trump hinted at potential military action against Cuba, addressed ongoing tensions with Iran, and criticized NATO allies for their lack of cooperation, even suggesting a possible withdrawal from the alliance.
summaries.zh: 特朗普总统暗示可能对古巴采取军事行动，谈及与伊朗的持续紧张局势，并批评北约盟友不合作，甚至暗示可能退出北约。
